sources.name: EPS-TOPIK NEW Standard Korean Textbook
sources.publisher: Human Resources Development Service of Korea (HRD Korea)
sources.license: Copyright HRD Korea; free official study download
sources.evidence: The copyright statement is on PDF page 2. Free download does not establish a commercial redistribution/adaptation licence.
sources.level: Official EPS-TOPIK study materials; 30 daily-life units and 30 workplace units
sources.audience: Adults preparing for employment in Korea. EPS-TOPIK is distinct from the general TOPIK exam. Workplace, safety and legal-system chapters are adult reference material.
sources.localScope: Two complete books with the corrections present in the official archives on retrieval. Archive member names record June 2025 and June 2026 corrections.

sources.name: Korean Through Folktales
sources.evidence: The downloaded PDF states CC BY-NC 4.0 on page 4. University OER; four stories with three proficiency versions each.
sources.level: Elementary, intermediate and advanced reading versions; supplementary reader
sources.audience: University language learners. A teacher should select culturally and developmentally appropriate passages for children.
sources.localScope: Complete revised reader from the eCampusOntario repository mirror.

sources.name: Français interactif
sources.publisher: COERLL, Department of French and Italian, University of Texas at Austin
sources.license: CC BY 4.0 for the fourth-edition textbook; inspect separately credited material
sources.evidence: Textbook PDF page 4 explicitly states CC BY 4.0. Attribute COERLL/UT Austin, link the licence, identify changes and preserve individual third-party credits. Companion references have their own source notices.
sources.level: Complete first-year university French curriculum; no verified CEFR certificate equivalence
sources.audience: University learners; younger learners need edited contexts and tasks.
sources.localScope: 345-page fourth-edition textbook, early-chapter review exercises and 251-verb reference. Publisher also links a newer Pressbooks edition; this is the available complete 2019 PDF edition.

sources.name: Beginning Spanish ¡Empecemos por aquí!
sources.license: CC BY-NC 4.0, with individual incorporated-OER credits
sources.evidence: Downloaded PDF page 2 identifies CC BY-NC 4.0. The university reader provides the PDF. Its PDF has 596 pages; the online viewer displays a different 608-page layout.
sources.level: Beginning university Spanish; six chapters containing 24 modules
sources.audience: Adult/college learners; communicative and cultural tasks.
sources.localScope: Complete PDF from the publisher's public reader, unchanged.

sources.name: Introducción al Español
sources.license: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, except where otherwise noted
sources.evidence: PDF page 4 states the licence and exceptions. Preserve attribution, noncommercial restriction and ShareAlike obligations on adaptations.
sources.audience: College learners; useful structured beginner reference.
sources.localScope: Complete 241-page PDF with links to audio and online interactive exercises; those interactives are not an offline app.

sources.publisher: Georgia Highlands College / Affordable Learning Georgia, University System of Georgia
sources.license: Site-level CC BY 4.0; mixed third-party material inside activity files
sources.evidence: The institutional record and course page show CC BY 4.0. Some activities reference or reproduce songs, films, stories and other third-party works. Do not treat every embedded item as CC BY or bulk-import them.
sources.level: Intermediate Spanish SPAN 2001/2002; supporting activities across ten chapters
sources.audience: College learners; includes cultural, literary and mature themes.
sources.localScope: Publicly linked PDF/DOCX vocabulary, listening, speaking, grammar, assignment and rubric files. This supplement set is not a newly accredited Wunder Tutor course.
